The scholarship aims to increase mutual understanding and friendship，to develop the communication and cooperation between China and the rest of the world in the field of education, technology, culture and economics. Nanjing University was founded in 1902, is well-known for its strong academic portfolio and outstanding professors. In fact, Nanjing University is one of the top 5 universities in China under the direct supervision of the Chinese Ministry of Education. Nanjing University is located in the heart of a historical city: Nanjing. It is surrounded by beautiful scenery, it has a picturesque environment and accessible transportation. Today’s NJU consists of 4 campuses: Gulou, Pukou, Xianlin and Suzhou. Up to now, over 30 schools and departments have been developed at Nanjing University. Currently, it hosts over 30,000 students, offering about 80 undergraduate programs, over 170 master's programs and more than 60 doctoral programs. Nanjing University adopts a credit system, and after acquiring the total number of credits for the degree and successfully passing the oral defence of the Graduation Paper, the students can apply for graduation. STUDENT TYPE: Master's and doctoral students MAJORS: Graduate Programs QUALIFICATIONS: 1. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens and be healthy both physically and mentally. 2. Academic background and age limit: Applicants for a master's degree must have acquired their bachelor's degrees, and should not be older than 35. Applicants for a doctoral degree must have acquired their master's degrees, and should not be older than 40. ※ For the graduates to obtain their degrees in 2027, they should submit a pre-graduation certificate to guarantee that they have the competence to complete their study and acquire the degree by July of 2027. 3. Language requirements: REQUIREMENTS FOR THE CHINESE-TAUGHT PROGRAMS: Admission requirement: Natural sciences, engineering & medicine: HSK level 4; Liberal arts, social sciences & business: HSK level 5. Graduation requirement： Natural sciences, engineering & medicine: HSK level 5; Liberal arts, social sciences & business: HSK level 6. REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ENGLISH-TAUGHT PROGRAMS: Admission requirement: IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 85/TOEFL Essentials 9/Duolingo English Test 100 (https://englishtest.duolingo.cn/applicants); Graduation requirement: HSK level 3. Applicants who do not meet the above requirements will not be accepted. ※ Students who have been granted other Chinese scholarships or funding （2027-2028） are not eligible for this scholarship. If a student was found to have the Chinese Government Scholarship and another Chinese scholarship at the same time, his/her Chinese Government Scholarship would be canceled immediately, and he/she would be required to return the scholarship that he/she had received before. Those who deliberately concealed the truth would not be permitted to apply for the Chinese Government Scholarship again within 3 years. YEAR LIMIT OF SCHOLARSHIP: The study duration is 2-3 years for master's students, and 4 years for doctoral students. REGULATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS FOR ANNUAL REVIEW: Scholarship students should study full-time at Nanjing University, and obey the university’s rules and regulations. The study, research, and thesis writing should be finished at the university. No long-distance education is permitted. Transferring school is not allowed either. Principally, students are not allowed to leave school, including visiting parents, referring to learning materials, or doing an internship during the school year unless during holidays. If there is an emergency, students can leave school with the permission notice of their advisors and departments along with the approval of the Institute for International Students. If a student violates the related regulations or leaves the university during the school year without any permission, his or her scholarship shall be suspended or even canceled. According to the regulations of the Chinese Scholarship Council, all scholarship students should take part in the annual review of the scholarship qualification. The time for annual review is from March to May every year. After the review, those who are qualified can keep their scholarships, while the scholarships of those who failed the assessment will be suspended or even canceled. GRANT STANDARD: 1. Allowance: During the scholarship duration, a monthly stipend of RMB 3,000 and RMB 3,500 will be provided for the master’s and doctoral students, respectively. 2. Tuition: Tuition will be waived. 3. Health Insurance: An insurance fee of RMB 800/year will be offered to the students during the scholarship duration, and they will be required to purchase the insurance accordingly. 4. Lodging: Free lodging in the international dormitory of the university will be provided for the students for the entire duration of the scholarship. APPLICATION PROCEDURE: 1. Between Nov. 1, 2026 and Jan. 20, 2027, register and apply at NJU’s China International Student Service System: https://nju.17gz.org/ . (For the program type, please choose "CSC Scholarship Type B".) The following documents will need to be uploaded. 1) Academic transcripts (applicants for the doctoral programs are required to upload the transcripts of both the bachelor's and master's programs); 2) Certificate of your highest diploma; 3) Two recommendation letters from the professors of the school you last attended (should be provided by professors or associate professors, and shall describe the applicant's objectives of learning in China, comprehensive abilities, and evaluation of future growth, as well as the cooperation between the supervisors or the exchange between universities both in China and abroad); 4) HSK test certificate (for the Chinese-taught programs) or IELTS/TOEFL/Duolingo English Test result (for the English-taught programs); 5) Personal Statement ( 个人陈述模板 Template of Personal Statement ); 6) List of papers published in professional or scientific journals & representative papers or abstracts of articles (optional); 7) Physical examination report 南京大学外国人体格检查记录 (must cover all the items listed in the form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid; test results obtained within 6 months); 8) First page of your passport; 9) Non-criminal record (obtained within 6 months); 10) Applicants for doctoral programs also need to supply the abstract of their master's program's graduation dissertation. 11) Those who apply for the programs of Architecture and Urban Planning need to submit a portfolio of relevant works. 2. After submitting the online application, you will receive feedback on our initial review within 3 workdays; if you received notices for resubmission, please re-upload the documents as required by the application deadline. 3. The applications that have passed the initial review will be transferred to the relevant schools/departments for further assessment in late Feb. 2027, and the result will be sent via system message and email in the first half of Mar. 2027. Those who have passed the further assessment will receive the pre-admission letter issued by Nanjing University (an applicant for the doctoral programs will also receive his/her personal statement with the supervisor's signature on it). 4. Before Mar. 17, 2027, those who have received NJU's pre-admission letter are required to register and apply on the CSC website ( http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/ . For Agency No., please fill in "10284"; for Program Type, please choose "B"). Before applying, please read Instructions for Chinese Government Scholarship Information System and Chinese Government Scholarship Application carefully. In the process, you will need to upload NJU's pre-admission letter (an applicant for the doctoral programs also needs to upload his/her personal statement with the supervisor's signature on it). (If you have already submitted the application on the CSC website before obtaining the pre-admission letter, please withdraw the application first, upload the letter, and then submit the application again.) If an applicant who has obtained NJU's pre-admission letter didn't submit the application at the CSC website before Mar. 17, we would assume that he/she had chosen to give up the nomination by Nanjing University. ※ If one of the original documents is neither written in Chinese nor in English, please also submit a notarized Chinese or English translation. ※ The applicants are responsible for the accuracy and authenticity of the submitted information and documents. If any dishonesty or falsification was found, the application would be invalid. ※ Please make sure that the documents uploaded to http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/ are the same as what you submit at https://nju.17gz.org/ , as the CSC will organize experts to evaluate your qualification again, mainly based on the documents you submit, before making the final admission decision. (In other words, not every student nominated by the university will be awarded the scholarship eventually.) ADMISSION & REGISTRATION: 1. After receiving the CSC’s final decision, Nanjing University will inform the applicants via email and system message, as well as post the admission documents to the new students. (Currently, it is difficult to predict when the final admission result will be announced. For your reference only, last year the result was announced in the first half of May.) 2. The new academic year is expected to start at the beginning of September 2027. You will find the specific dates of registration on the admission notice. 3. When coming to NJU to register, the new students will be required to bring the admission notice, JW201 form (hard or soft copy), physical examination report, original highest diploma, etc. for the qualification review. (If the original copy is neither written in Chinese nor in English, a notarized Chinese or English translation will need to be submitted.) The scholarship of those who didn't pass the review would be canceled. For further inquiries, please contact: Ms. Wang Dongxu Scholarship Coordinator Institute for International Students RM. 514 Zeng Xianzi Building, 18 Jinyin Street, Nanjing 210008, China Tel.: +86-25-83594535 Fax: +86-25-83316747 Email: wangdongxu@nju.edu.cn

XMU has long been listed among China’s leading universities on the national 211 Project, 985 Project and Double First-Class Initiative, which have been launched by the Chinese government to support selected universities in achieving world-class standing. Nestled snugly between green hills and the blue sea, XMU is renowned as one of the most beautiful universities around the world for its excellent education facilities and beautiful environment. Xiamen University currently comprises Siming Campus, Zhangzhou Campus, Xiang’an Campus and XMU Malaysia. XMU consists of a graduate school, six academic divisions, 36 schools and 18 research institutes. In 2022, six XMU disciplines –Chemistry, Marine Science, Biology, Ecology, Statistics and Pedagogy – w ere included in the nation’s list of disciplines for achieving world-class status. XMU ranks among ESI’s global top 1% in 19 disciplines, with chemistry, materials science and engineering in ESI’s global top 1‰. XMU currently has a faculty of nearly 3,000, of whom 73% are full or associate professors. Among them, 14 are the members of the Chinese Academy of Sciences or of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. XMU currently has an enrollment of more than 48,000 students, including over 21,700 students in bachelor’s degree programs, 20,000 in master’s degree programs, and 6,800 in doctoral degree programs. XMU implements a comprehensive global outreach strategy. The University has signed cooperation agreements with 283 overseas universities. Actively involved in international Chinese education, XMU has built 14 Confucius Institutes, one Chinese Language and Culture Research Center, 34 Confucius Classrooms in 12 countries on five continents, the highest numbers with the most extensive geographic coverage among Chinese universities on the List of “Double First-Class” Universities. The establishment of XMU Malaysia was approved in September 2013, which makes XMU the first Chinese university to open an international campus. I. Eligibility 1. General Requirements 1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens generally under the age of 45 (as of September 1, 2027), be mentally and physically healthy, and possess a valid regular passport. 2) Applicants should be a graduating student of an undergraduate’s program or hold a Bachelor Degree or above. 3) Scholarship applicants should also meet the age limit requirements of respective scholarships. 2. Requirements about Nationalities Foreign citizens of Chinese origin, including former Chinese citizens who have obtained foreign citizenship, as well as the non-Chinese descendants of present or former Chinese citizens, will have to follow the system instructions to fill in the basic information and upload the supporting documents based on the different citizenship status, and will be subject to a preliminary review of citizenship status by XMU during the admission stage and to verification of citizenship by the entry and exit administration department of China’s public security authorities. Applicants who fail to pass the preliminary review or verification of citizenship will be deemed to have forfeited their eligibility for admission, as well as the subsequent academic registration that they may obtain. 3. Language Proficiency Requirement 1) Chinese proficiency requirements for Chinese-medium programs Ø Programs in Humanities, Economics, Management, Law, Arts : HSK 5 with a score of 210 or better Ø Programs in Sciences, Engineering, Medicine and Physical Education : HSK 4 with a score of 210 or better Ø OR Chinese-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from previous university where Chinese is the primary language of instruction. 2) English proficiency requirements for English-medium programs Ø TOEFL iBT Certificate: an overall minimum score of 80 (XMU's DI Code for TOEFL is C310) Ø OR an IELTS Academic Certificate: an overall minimum score of 6.0 Ø OR English-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from previous university where English is the primary language of instruction. Ø OR other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by XMU Ø Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from this requirement. II. Application Timeline Start Time Deadline Scholarship Category Dec. 1, 2026 Feb 20, 2027 Chinese Government Scholarships Apr. 30, 2027 Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship Sustainable Coastal Development Scholarship of Xiamen University Xiamen University Scholarship for New Students May 31, 2027 Self-funded Notes: 1. Applicable to XMU Online Application System, Beijing Time (GMT +08:00), late applications will not be considered. 2. NOT applicable to Type A CSC scholarships and International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship. Please refer to the official notice of the MOE’s Center for Language Education and Cooperation, China Scholarship Council (Chinese Embassy or other handling authorities) for more details. III. Application Procedures Applicants should apply through XMU Online Application System for international students and pay the application fee: http://application.xmu.edu.cn IV. Application Documents 1. A scanned copy of the first page of the passport (regular passport, valid at least through October 31, 2027) 2. Birth Certificate 3. Parents’ Identity Documents 4. Degree Certificate and the Academic Transcripts 1) Bachelor Degree Certificate or above and the complete academic transcripts. 2) Certificate of Expected Graduation for graduating students. 3) Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland should be notarized by the local notary public office. 4) The originals of the diplomas and certification documents should be made available upon registration for review. 5. Language Proficiency Certificate: marked under the “Application Requirements” section. 6. Two Letters of Recommendation from associate professors or professors with information of the recommender’s names, employer, work position and contact information, signed by the recommender or with the stamp of the recommending organization. 7. Personal Statement (minimum 1,000 words), which should include a self-introduction, educational experience, motivations, study plan and career aspirations. It needs to be written in Chinese for Chinese-medium programs, in English for English-medium programs. Note: Applicants for School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics, please refer to 【 Writing Guidance 】 . 8. Curriculum Vitae (CV) 9. Pre-Acceptance Letter (optional). Priority of admission will be given to applicants have acquired the pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the college. Link: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1141/1969.htm 10. Physical Examination Record for Inbound Travelers including chest X-ray image, electrocardiogram, laboratory exam results and data sheets of some required items, with the lower part of the applicant’s photo stamped by the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months. Link: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1141/1745.htm 11. Financial Support Guarantee Statement and its supporting documents. Applicants for scholarships are not exempt from this requirement. Link: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1141/1744.htm 12. No Criminal Record Report. The applicants shall submit a valid No Criminal Record Report issued within 6 months before the date of submission of the application. 13. Personal portfolios such as videos and artworks, are REQUIRED for art applicants. Other supporting documents, such as publications, competition awards, merit certificates, scientific research activities, academic conference attendance or special skills certificates, could be submitted in the “Other Supporting Materials” section in the application system as well. Notes: 1. After the application is submitted, the applicant will not be able to modify the application information or application materials. Therefore, before submitting your application, please check carefully to ensure that the information and materials submitted are comprehensive, true and complete. Applications with inaccuracies or omissions will not be accepted by the University. Action for misconduct will be taken according to “Monitoring, complaints and action for misconduct”. 2. Any documents in a language other than Chinese or English should be accompanied by a notarized translation in Chinese or English. 3. In general, there is no need to mail original hard-copy materials through courier service. However, under extraordinary circumstances, the University reserves the rights to require applicants to mail original hard-copy documents for further review and identification or to carry out authentication as specified. Application materials will not be returned under any circumstances. V. Academic Programs 1. Chinese-medium Master’s Programs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Programs/Chinese_Medium_Master_s.htm 2. English-medium Master’s Programs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Programs/English_Medium_Master_s.htm Notes: Generally the minimum number of students in a single program should be no less than 5. VI. Admission and Selection 1. Verification of qualification There will be a holistic review of the applicant’s foreign citizenship, highest degree diploma, academic performance, language proficiency, research plan, recommendations, physical and mental health, etc. 2. Academic assessment For applicants who pass the verification of qualifications, the relevant colleges or schools will conduct academic assessment, including evaluation of the application documents as well as a remote interview or written examination of the applicant. The academic assessment focuses on the applicant’s academic capabilities, communicative competence, overall merit, etc. 3. The admission decision will be made based on the verification of the applicant’s qualifications and academic assessment results, as well as their program choices. Applicants should log into XMU Online Application System regularly for notifications and the progress of application status, and keep their phones open and check their email accounts regularly. The outcome of application will be published on the application system in June or July. VII. Length of Program, Duration of Study and Conferral of Degree 1. Length of Chinese-medium Master’s Programs: 3 years Notes: 2 years for International Chinese Language Education (045300); The Chines-Foreign Cooperatively-Run Master's Degree Program in Drama Film and Television (135400) by Xiamen University and New York Film Academy adopts a 1+1 dual-degree and dual-campus, full-time training model, with a duration of 2 years. All students will study at Xiamen University in the first academic year and at the New York Film Academy (Los Angeles campus) in the second academic year. 2. Length of English-medium Master’s program: 2 years Notes: The master's degree program in Design (135700) at the Institute of Creativity and Innovation (ICI), a Sino-foreign cooperative education program jointly offered by Xiamen University (XMU) and the University for the Creative Arts (UCA), UK, adopts a “2+0” training model. Students who fulfill the graduation requirements within the maximum period of study and meet the conditions for degree conferral may obtain a Master's Program Graduation Certificate and a Master's Degree Certificate awarded by XMU, as well as a Master of Arts in Design conferred by UCA. 3. Maximum duration of study (including suspension and retainment of student status): 5 years 4. Time of enrolment: Autumn, usually in September. Students will be awarded a graduation certificate by XMU after they complete all the courses prescribed in the academic scheme obtaining required credits, pass the defense of graduation thesis or practical achievements and satisfy the graduation requirements within the duration of study prescribed by XMU. Those who have also satisfied the requirements for degree conferral will be conferred a Master’s Degree by XMU. VIII. Study Cost Application Fee RMB 400 (payable upon signing up online; non-refundable) Tuition Fee Program Category Medium of Instruction Length of Program (year) Discipline Category (RMB/year) Liberal Arts Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Economics, Management, Law, PE Regular Master’s Programs Chinese 3 26000 30000 English 2 39000 45000 Master of International Chinese Language Education(045300) Chinese 2 30000 Drama Film and Television (Chinese-Foreign Cooperation) Chinese 2 172000 Design (Chinese-Foreign Cooperation) English 2 120000 Notes: Tuition fees are payable in RMB by academic year and do not include textbook fees. Tuition fees are subject to change without prior notice upon approval by price regulators. Other Expenses 1. Accommodation (1) Due to the limited availability of on-campus accommodation, priority will be given to students who are recipients of scholarships that include subsidies for on-campus accommodation. Surplus accommodation will be allotted to students who are recipients of scholarships with no subsidies for accommodation and self-funded students. Students with on-campus accommodation can live in on-campus housing until July 31 of the academic year. (2) Siming campus: twin-rooms, accommodation fees (electricity and water not included, the same below) range from RMB 35 to 65 per person per day; Xiang’an campus: quadruple-rooms or twin-rooms, accommodation fees range from RMB 1200 to 4000 per person per academic year; Zhangzhou campus: quadruple-rooms, accommodation fees range from RMB 1100 to 1200 per person per academic year. Each room is usually equipped with beds, desks and chairs, wardrobes, an air conditioner, a water heater, a bathroom (suites have a different bathroom arrangement), and Internet access (paid by students). Communal self-service washers and other equipment are also available. Details shall be subject to the dormitory arrangement at the time of new student check-in. (3) Students who cannot obtain on-campus accommodation are expected to arrange for their own off-campus accommodation before their arrival. The monthly rental fee for an apartment near Siming campus is around RMB 2,500/month, and RMB500-1000/month near Xiang’an Campus. (4) Recipients of Chinese Government Scholarships or International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarships that cover on-campus accommodation expenses can apply for an accommodation subsidy if they give up free on-campus accommodation and choose to live off campus. Please refer to the updates. 2. Food: approximately RMB 1,000 to 1,500/month 3. Medical Insurance: For the safety of international students in China, according to the regulations of the Chinese Ministry of Education and Xiamen University, international students are required to purchase medical insurance for an annual fee of RMB 800. Please refer to the enrolment instructions for detailed information of medical insurance. Note: 1. For more information about accommodation, insurance or scholarship Stipend, please contact Overseas Students Affairs Office (OSAO, Tel:+ 86 (0)592 2183606, Email: osao@xmu.edu.cn ). 2. Xiamen University follows tuition policies of the Chinese government strictly. Fee charging shall be carried on in accordance with regulations stipulated in the admission guidance. Do not trust any school fee payment notice other than the admission guidance and the enrollment instructions. IX. Scholarship Programs (I) Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type A) 1. Chinese Government Scholarships – Bilateral Programs Applicants who are eligible for the “Chinese Government Scholarship – Country-Specific Bilateral Program” can submit the applications to their home country’s international student dispatching department or the education office of the Chinese embassy (consulate) in their home country. In general, the application period is from January to early April every year. However, application deadlines may vary from country to country. Please follow the updates of the local Chinese embassy (consulate). https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1882.htm 2. MOFCOM Scholarship MOFCOM Scholarship supports English medium graduate programs. Applicants can apply to the Economic and Commercial Counselor's Office (ECCO) of the local Chinese Embassy before May each year. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1851.htm 3. ASEAN-China Young Leaders Scholarship (ACYLS) This scholarship provides financial support for young professionals with work experience who are from ASEAN member countries and who are studying for a master’s or doctoral degree, receiving short-term advanced training, or participating in short-term group training programs. Applicants can apply to the ACYLS national focal points from early January to early April. https://www.campuschina.org/content/details3_380333.html 4. Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program ("YES China") Xiamen University enrolls master students in English-medium programs of Marine Affairs, Chemical Engineering or Urban and Regional Planning under YES China. In the first year, the students mainly complete the course study, research and preparation of the dissertation, and in the second year, the students return to their home countries to complete and defend their thesis, and those who are qualified will be allowed to graduate and obtain the degree. Applicants belonging to one of the following four categories of personnel can apply by mid-April in CSC system: ① Civil servants at the rank of section chief or above (or equivalent) in a government department of their home country; ② Senior managerial personnel at institutions or enterprises; ③ Administrative personnel at universities or research institutes; ④ Personnel with work or internship experience with an international organization Urban and Regional Planning: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/3730.htm Marine Affairs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/2409.htm ( II ) Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type B) Eligible applicants should submit their applications for admission and scholarships through XMU Online Application System for international students ( application.xmu.edu.cn ) within the application period specified in the prospectus; they should also register on the “Chinese Government Scholarship Information System” ( studyinchina.csc.edu.cn ). Agency No. XMU: 10384. 1. Chinese Government Scholarship University Programs Xiamen University, as an enrolling institution under the Chinese Government Scholarship Programs, admits students from around the world who are recipients of such scholarships. XMU will submits information on such students to the China Scholarship Council for approval. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1863.htm 2. Chinese Government Marine Scholarship This scholarship is open to international students from countries around the South China Sea and the Indian Ocean and on the Pacific Rim and islands, as well as from developing countries in Africa and the Americas, who wish to come to China to pursue a master’s or doctoral degree in a marine-related field. Preference will be given to those working in the marine industry or other related industries. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1865.htm (III) International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship The MOE’s Center for Language Education and Cooperation have launched this scholarship program with a view to encouraging students and Chinese language teachers from all over the world to study or conduct research on the Chinese language and culture. The scholarship is opened to applicants for 2-year Master’s Program of International Chinese Language Education (Major Code 045300). Applicants should contact Confucius Institutes, independently operated Confucius Classrooms, certain HSK test centers, Chinese language (education) departments of foreign universities, or Chinese embassies (consulates) in their home countries for recommendation. Eligible applicants should submit their applications on the “International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Application System” ( cis.chinese.cn ) within the application period. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Scholarships/International_Chinese_Language_Teachers_Scholars.htm (IV) Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students The Scholarship is open to international students who wish to study in degree programs in Fujian Province. It is available only for one academic year and amounts to RMB 30,000 for undergraduates, RMB 40,000 for master’s students and RMB 50,000 for doctoral students. The University will select the best candidates from the pool of students who have passed the annual review. The shortlisted students will be recommended for the renewal of the scholarship in the subsequent year. Applicants should submit their applications for admission and the scholarship through XMU Online Application System for international students ( application.xmu.edu.cn ) within the application period specified in the admission prospectus. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Scholarships/Fujian_Provincial_Govt__Scholarship.htm (V) Xiamen University Scholarship for New International Students XMU offers the university scholarships of first, second and third prizes. Each year, a number of undergraduate, master’s and doctoral students are selected from applicants. Recipients will be awarded full or partial tuition exemption. For some outstanding students, a monthly stipend can be provided in accordance with the standards of the Chinese Government Scholarship. Students shall submit their admission application and scholarship application via the university’s application system within the specified application period. ( application.xmu.edu.cn ). https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Scholarships/Xiamen_University_Scholarships.htm Notes: 1. This admission guide may be adjusted according to the latest notice of scholarship authorities and so please refer to the latest version under “Scholarships” section on https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/ . 2. According to the XMU’s Guidelines on Selecting Candidates for International Students Scholarships, the University will follow the principle of formality, equality and impartiality and select the best candidates from the pool of qualified and admitted students. The shortlisted candidates will be submitted to the university and the relevant scholarship authorities for final approval. The scholarship recipients will be assessed on an annual basis in accordance with the relevant scholarship regulations and only those meeting the required standards will have their scholarship renewed for the subsequent year. Those who fail in the review will no longer be eligible for the scholarship. X. Monitoring, Complaints and Action for Misconduct 1. Required by the competent department, the information related to application and admission will be published on XMU Admissions Web ( https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn ) or websites of relevant schools. Beware of any fake news from other sources. 2. Under the guidance of the XMU Admissions Committee, XMU’s international student recruitment is jointly conducted by its Admissions Office and the relevant schools/colleges and is subject to the monitoring of the University’s Supervision Division (Tel: +86 (0)592 2186219). 3. Applicants are responsible for the truthfulness and accuracy of the information and documents they have submitted. Scholarship Xiamen Tan Kah Kee Scholarships Xiamen University Scholarships XMU Sustainable Coastal Development Scholarship International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship 2026, Xiamen University To meet the growing international demand for Chinese language teachers, facilitate Chinese language education around the world, and support the professional development of Chinese language teachers, the Center for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC) has established the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship (hereinafter referred to as the Scholarship) for eligible Chinese language teachers outside of China. Confucius Institutes, independent Confucius Classrooms, selected HSK test centers, foreign educational institutions, Chinese language teacher training programs/Chinese departments at foreign universities, professional associations for Chinese language teaching, Chinese embassies (consulates) abroad (hereinafter collectively referred to as Recommending Institutions) may recommend outstanding students and in-service Chinese language teachers to further their studies in international Chinese language education and related programs at Chinese universities (hereinafter referred to as Host Institutions). Xiamen University is among the universities that recruit international students under this scholarship scheme. Xiamen University (XMU), founded in 1921 by renowned patriotic overseas Chinese leader Mr. Tan Kah Kee, was the first Chinese university established by an overseas Chinese person. XMU has long been listed among China’s leading universities on the national 211 Project, 985 Project and Double First-Class Initiative, which have been launched by the Chinese government to support selected universities in achieving world-class standing. Nestled snugly between green hills and the blue sea, XMU is renowned as one of the most beautiful universities around the world for its excellent education facilities and beautiful environment. Xiamen University currently comprises Siming Campus, Zhangzhou Campus, Xiang’an Campus and XMU Malaysia. XMU consists of a graduate school, six academic divisions, 35 schools and 17 research institutes. In 2022, six XMU disciplines –Chemistry, Marine Science, Biology, Ecology, Statistics and Pedagogy – were included in the nation’s list of disciplines for achieving world-class status. XMU ranks among ESI’s global top 1% in 19 disciplines, with chemistry, materials science and engineering in ESI’s global top 1‰. XMU currently has a faculty of nearly 3,000, of whom 74% are full or associate professors. Among them, 15 are the members of the Chinese Academy of Sciences or of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. XMU currently has an enrollment of more than 47,000 students, including over 21,000 students in bachelor’s degree programs, 20,000 in master’s degree programs, and 6,000 in doctoral degree programs. XMU implements a comprehensive global outreach strategy. The University has signed cooperation agreements with 277 overseas universities. Actively involved in international Chinese education, XMU has built 14 Confucius Institutes, one Chinese Language and Culture Research Center, 34 Confucius Classrooms in 12 countries on five continents, the highest numbers with the most extensive geographic coverage among Chinese universities on the List of “Double First-Class” Universities. The establishment of XMU Malaysia was approved in September 2013, which makes XMU the first Chinese university to open an international campus. I. ELIGIBILITY 1. Be a non-Chinese citizen; 2. Be friendly to China, have no criminal record, abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of the Host Institution; 3. Be in good physical and mental health, be in good academic and behavioral standing; 4. Be interested in Chinese language education and related work; 5. Be aged between 16 and 35 years on September 1, 2026. The maximum age limit for in-service Chinese teachers may be extended to 45, but those who apply for a scholarship for a Bachelor’s degree shall be younger than 25 under most circumstances. Notes: Foreign citizens of Chinese origin, including former Chinese citizens who have obtained foreign citizenship, as well as the non-Chinese descendants of present or former Chinese citizens, will be subject to a preliminary review of citizenship status by XMU during the admission stage, and to verification of citizenship by the entry and exit administration department of China's public security authorities. Applicants who fail to pass the preliminary review or verification of citizenship will be deemed to have voluntarily relinquished their eligibility for admission, as well as the subsequent academic registration that they may obtain. II. CATEGORIES AND QUALIFICATIONS 1. Scholarship for Master's Degree in International Chinese Language Education The program commences in September 2026 and provides scholarship for a maximum of two academic years. Applicants shall hold a Bachelor's degree, and have a minimum score of 210 on the HSK Test (Level 5) as well as 60 on the HSKK test (Intermediate Level). Priority will be given to applicants who may provide a work contract with a teaching institution upon completing their studies in China or a proof to the same effect. 2. Scholarship for Bachelor's Degree in International Chinese Language Education (the major of Chinese language) The program commences in September 2026, and the scholarship is provided for a maximum of four academic years. Applicants shall hold a senior high school diploma and have a minimum score of 210 on the HSK Test (Level 4) and 60 on the HSKK test (Intermediate Level). Priority will be given to applicants who may provide a work contract with a teaching institution upon completing their studies in China or a proof to the same effect. 3. Scholarship for One-Academic-Year Study The program commences in September 2026, and provides scholarship for a maximum of eleven months. International students who have benefited from similar scholarships within 3 years are not eligible. i. International Chinese language education programs: Applicants shall have a minimum score of 270 on the HSK test (Level 3), and an HSKK test score is required. ii. Chinese Language Study: Applicants shall have a minimum score of 210 on the HSK test (Level 3). Priority will be given to applicants who provide an HSKK test score. 4. Scholarship for One-Semester Study The program commences either in September 2026 or March 2027, and provides scholarship of a maximum of five months. International students who have benefited from similar scholarships within 3 years are not eligible. Applicants for the area of international Chinese language education shall have a minimum score of 180 on the HSK test (Level 3), and an HSKK test score is required. 5. Scholarship for Four-Week Study The program commences either in July or December, 2026, and provides a four-week scholarship. For the areas of Chinese Study, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Taiji Culture, Chinese Language plus Home-Stay Experience in a Chinese Family, and Special Four-week Program for Confucius Institutes, applicants are required to provide HSK test scores. The program may be organized and applied for by a recommending institution with 10-15 participants per group. Prior to the trip, a detailed study plan shall be made in consultation with host institutions and such plan shall be submitted to CLEC for approval. III. APPLICATION PROCEDURES Online registration on the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship application website ( http://cis.chinese.cn ) will be available from March 1st, 2026 . For programs commencing in September, student application must complete before May 15th . Please log on to search for recommending institutions and host institutions; upload application materials online; and track the application progress, comments and results. Scholarship holders need to confirm with the host institutions to go through the procedures of studying in China, print out the scholarship certificate online, and register at host institutions on the designated date as per the letter of admission. The application deadlines (Beijing Time) are: 1. For programs commencing in July (Four-Week Study Program), student application must complete before April 15th; recommending institutions and Xiamen University must complete review before April 25th; 2.For programs commencing in September, student application must complete before May 15th; recommending institutions and Xiamen University must complete review before May 25th; 3. For programs commencing in December (Four-Week Study Program), student application must complete before September 15th; recommending institutions and Xiamen University must complete review before September 25th; 4. For programs commencing in March 2027 (One-Semester Study Program), student application must complete before October 31th, 2026; recommending institutions and Xiamen University must complete review before November 10th, 2026. CLEC will entrust an expert panel to review the applications. Decisions will be made based on HSK and HSKK levels and scores, geographical distribution, and other factors. The results will be published about three months before the program starts. IV. Application Documents for International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Please refer to the attached list of application materials for the International Chinese Teachers Scholarship. Applicants should also provide other supporting documents required by the University according to the provisions of the relevant enrollment regulations of the University or other practical needs: 1.Admissions Guide for the Long-Term Chinese Language Program: https://oec.xmu.edu.cn/en/Program/Long_term_Chinese.htm 2. Application Guide to Bachelor's Programs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Admissions/Undergraduate_Students.htm 3. Application Guide to Master's Programs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Admissions/Master_s_Students.htm V. Policies Regarding Currently Employed Chinese Language Teachers and Chinese Bridge Award Recipients 1.In-Service Chinese Language Teachers Priority will be given to In-service Chinese language teachers who provide proof of employment and a letter of recommendation from the employer. 2. Chinese Bridge Winners Applicants who have won the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Certificate in various Chinese Bridge competitions should submit their application documents along with their scholarship certificates to Xiamen University on the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship website. For further inquiry, please contact chinesebridge@chinese.cn. VI. OTHERS 1. In principle, applicants who have received a similar scholarship within three years are not eligible for the One-Semester Study Program or One-Year Study Program. 2. For course schedule in the program of Chinese Language and International Chinese language education, as well as the training plan of the Four-Week Study programs, please contact Chinese International Education College/Overseas Education College of Xiamen University at oec@xmu.edu.cn. 3. Applicants shall be familiar with the specific criteria and deadlines for registration, and submit necessary documents according to specific requirements. 4. Degree students are subject to the annual assessment according to the Annual Appraisal Procedures of International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship. 5．For enrollment and other matters, please contact us in a timely manner. 6. Students who fail to pass the pre-enrollment medical examination, withdraw from school midway, or fail to report to school or suspend their studies without permission will be disqualified for scholarship. 7. The English version of this Guide is provided for reference and as a general guide only. In case of any discrepancy between the English and Chinese versions, the Chinese version shall prevail. This application guide may be adjusted by the latest notice from the competent department of scholarship or the requirements of our university. VII. APPENDIXES Appendix 1 International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Coverage and Standard The scholarship covers tuition, accommodation fees, living allowance (excluding Four-Week Study Program students), and comprehensive medical insurance. 1. Tuition is managed comprehensively by the Host Institution for the training and management of scholarship students, the organization of cultural activities, and the administration of Chinese proficiency tests. 2. Accommodation fees are managed comprehensively by the Host Institution to provide free on-campus housing (generally double rooms) for students. If a scholarship student applies for and receives permission from the Host Institution to live off-campus, the Host Institution will issue a monthly or quarterly accommodation allowance. The allowance is RMB 1,000/month for doctoral students and RMB 700/month for other scholarship categories. 3. The living allowance is distributed by the Host Institution on a monthly basis. The standard rate for undergraduates, One-Year, and One-Semester students is RMB 2,500/month; for Master’s students in International Chinese Language Education is RMB 3,000/month; and for Doctoral students in International Chinese Language Education is RMB 3,500/month. Scholarship students must register at the Host Institution by the time stipulated in the Admission Letter; failure to do so will result in the cancellation of the scholarship. Students who register on or before the 15th of the month will receive the full monthly allowance; those who register after the 15th will receive half of the monthly allowance. If a scholarship student leaves China for personal reasons for more than 15 days during the study period (excluding winter and summer breaks), the living allowance will be suspended for the duration of their absence. If a scholarship student suspends their studies, withdraws from school, or receives disciplinary action from the Host Institution for personal reasons, the living allowance will be suspended starting from the date of suspension, withdrawal, or penalty notification. For graduating students, the living allowance is issued up to half a month after the graduation date confirmed by the school. 4. Comprehensive medical insurance expenses are implemented in accordance with relevant regulations from the Ministry of Education of China regarding international students studying in China and are purchased by the Host Institution. The standard for Four-Week Study Program students is RMB 100/person; for One-Semester Study Program students is RMB 400/person; and for students studying for more than one year is RMB 800/person/year. Appendix 2 List of Application Materials for International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship I. General Documents (Required for All Applicants) 1. Scanned copy of passport photo page. 2. Scanned copy of HSK and HSKK score reports (valid for two years). 3. Recommendation letter from the head of the Recommending Institution. II. Additional Documents for Degree Students 4. Proof of highest academic qualification (or proof of expected graduation) and academic transcripts. 5. Doctoral students in International Chinese Language Education must provide two recommendation letters from associate professors or professors or experts with equivalent professional titles in relevant fields. They must provide a personal statement in Chinese (approx. 3,000 words), detailing their understanding of the intended major and their research plan. Priority will be given to applicants who provide an employment agreement (or equivalent proof) from a teaching institution for post-graduation employment. 6. Master’s Students in International Chinese Language Education) must provide recommendation letters from two supervisors holding the title of associate professor or above. Priority will be given to applicants who provide an employment agreement (or equivalent proof) from a teaching institution for post-graduation employment. III. In-service Chinese Language Teachers must attach proof of employment and a recommendation letter issued by their employer. IV. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit entrusted guardianship documents signed by a guardian in China. Applicants must also provide any other proof materials required by the Host Institution. Priority will be given to applicants who may provide an employment contract with a teaching institution upon completing their studies in China or proof to the same effect. Scholarship for Master’s Degree in International Chinese Language Education The program commences in September 2026 , and the scholarship is provided for a maximum of two academic years. Applicants shall hold a Bachelor’s degree. Applicants shall have a minimum score of 210 on the HSK Test (Level 5) and 60 on the HSKK test (Intermediate Level). Priority will be given to applicants who may provide an employment contract with a teaching institution upon completing their studies in China or proof to the same effect. Scholarship for Bachelor’s Degree in Chinese Language and Literature (International Chinese Language Education) The program commences in September 2026 , and the scholarship is provided for a maximum of four academic years. Applicants shall hold a senior high school diploma and have a minimum score of 210 on the HSK Test (Level 4) and 60 on the HSKK test (Intermediate Level). Priority will be given to applicants who may provide an employment contract with a teaching institution upon completing their studies in China or proof to the same effect. Scholarship for One-Year Study Program The program commences in September 2026 , and the scholarship is provided for a maximum of eleven months. For the area of International Chinese Language Education, applicants shall have a minimum score of 270 on the HSK test (Level 3), and an HSKK test score is required. For the area of Chinese language and literature, applicants shall have a minimum score of 180 on the HSK test (Level 4 ) and 60 on the HSKK test (Intermediate Level). For the area of Chinese Language Study, applicants shall have a minimum score of 210 on the HSK test (Level 3). Priority will be given to applicants who provide an HSKK test score. Scholarship for One-Semester Study Program The program commences either in September 2026 or March 202 7 , and the scholarship is provided for a maximum of five months. T he areas of International Chinese Language Education , Chinese language and literature are available. Applicants shall have a minimum score of 180 on the HSK test (Level 3), and an HSKK test score is required. Scholarship for Four-Week Study Program The program commences either in July or December 2026 , and the scholarship is provided for a maximum of four weeks. For the areas of Chinese Language Study, traditional Chinese medicine, Taiji culture , applicants are required to provide HSK test scores. The p rogram may be organized and applied for by a recommending. institution with 15 participants or more per group. Before the trip, a detailed study plan shall be made in consultation with host institutions and such plan shall be submitted to CLEC for review and approval. 3. COVERAGE International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship provides full coverage on tuition fee, accommodation fee, living allowance (four-week study students are excluded) and comprehensive medical insurance expenses. 4. APPLICATION PROCEDURES Online registration will be available from March 1, 2026 on the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship website ( http://www.chinese.cn ). You may search for Recommending Institutions and Host Institutions; submit application materials online; and track the application process. The successful applicant must confirm with the Host Institutions to go through the procedures of studying in China, print out the scholarship certificate online, and register at the Host Institution on the designated date as per the Letter of Admission. The Application Deadlines (Beijing Time) : Apr 15, 2026 (for programs commencing in July ,2026 ) May 15, 2026 (for programs commencing in September ,2026 ) Sep 15, 2026 (for programs commencing in December ,2026 ) Oct 31, 2026 (for programs commencing in March 202 7 ) CLEC will entrust an expert panel to review the applications. Decisions will be based on HSK and HSKK levels and scores, geographical distribution, and other factors. The results will be published about three months before the program starts. 5. POLICIES REGARDING IN-SERVICE CHINESE LANGUAGE TEACHERS AND CHINESE BRIDGE WINNERS In-Service Chinese language Teachers: In-service Chinese language teachers may be given priority to admission under the same conditions if they provide proof of employment and recommendation from their employer. Chinese Bridge Winners: Applicants who have received the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Certificate during Chinese Bridge competitions may submit their application documents along with their scholarship certificates to BLCU directly at the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship website. For further inquiry, please contact " chinesebridge@chinese.cn . " 6. APPLICATION MATERIALS FOR INTERNATIONAL CHINESE LANGUAGE TEACHERS SCHOLARSHIP For All Applicants: A scanned copy of passport photo page; A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK and HSKK tests (within the two-year validity); For Bachelor’s program，take the CSCA before the application deadline, and obtain a valid Score Report. A reference letter by the head of the recommending institutions. A certificate of the highest education diploma (or proof of expected graduation. Students with proof of expected graduation must submit formal certificate of the highest education diploma before the starting and registration time of BLCU.) - For Degree Program Applicants: 1. For Applicants of the Scholarship for a Doctor’s Degree An official transcript of the highest education study ( transcript of every semester is needed) . 2 reference letters from professors or associate professors or experts with equivalent professional and technical titles in relevant fields. A 3000-word personal statement in Chinese (including knowledge of the intended field of study and research proposal). The acceptance letter of the supervisor in relevant fields. Priority will be given to applicants who may provide an employment contract with a teaching institution upon completing their studies in China or a proof to the same effect. 2. For Applicants of the Scholarship for a Master’s Degree An official transcript of the highest education study ( transcript of every semester is needed) . 2 reference letters from professors or associate professors. A study plan (including CV, education background, Chinese language proficiency, personal statement on research ability, research proposal, and career plan) above 800 Chinese words. Priority will be given to applicants who may provide an employment contract with a teaching institution upon completing their studies in China or a proof to the same effect. 3. For Applicants of the Scholarship for a Bachelor’s Degree a. An official transcript of the highest education study ( transcript of every semester is needed) . - Other Required Application Materials In-service Chinese language teachers shall provide proof of employment and a re ference letter from the employer. For applicants under the age of 18, their parents should entrust a non-Chinese citizen residing in China or a Chinese residing in Beijing with the student’s guardianship, and provide notarized guardianship guarantee statement. - Note Those who provide false documents, or conceal the visa record in their passports when applying for the scholarship, will be canceled from the scholarship once verified. All the consequences caused by providing false documents shall be borne by applicants themselves. Additional documents will be required by BLCU on certain conditions. 7. OTHERS I n principle applicants who had awarded the one-semester program and the one-year program scholarships within three years will not be admitted to the same type of scholarship . For major training plans and courses, please refer to study at BLCU website for international students: http://a.blcu.edu.cn Degree students are subject to the annual assessment according to the Annual Assessment Procedures of the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship. For enrollment and other matters, please contact BLCU. Students who fail to pass the pre-enrollment medical examination, withdraw from school before completing the program, fail to register at the university without prior permission, or suspend their studies will be disqualified for the scholarship. Each applicant can only apply for one scholarship provided by Chinese government. Multiple applications for different scholarships will be considered invalid and such applicants will be disqualified from scholarship. 8. pku-grad.text: 2027 Application Information for International Students (Master's Degree and Ph.D. Degree) 请输入关键字 确定 En 首页 关于我们 学校介绍 留学寄语 如何到达 联系我们 留学申请 本科生 研究生 交换生 进修生 预科生 国际暑期学院 国际短期课程 奖学金 奖学金公告 奖学金项目 校园文化 多彩活动 认识中国 认识世界 生活服务 学业指导 生活服务 住宿与设施 签证手续 毕业手续 规章制度 学籍学历 就业实习 政策手续 就业信息 实习信息 留学生校友 常用下载 招生简章类 申请类 奖学金类 手册类 院系相关类 2027 Application Information for International Students (Master's Degree and Ph.D. Degree) 时间：2026-10-23 Peking University (PKU) is a comprehensive research university with disciplines ranging from philosophy, literature, history, law, economics, and education to science, engineering, medicine, management, art, and interdisciplinary studies. Peking University enrolls international students to pursue master’s and Ph.D. degrees through the “Application + Examination” method, and is dedicated to educating innovation-minded scholars with a global perspective and an understanding of China. This admissions prospectus is intended for applicants to the Yanyuan campus (Haidian District, Beijing); the new Yanyuan campus (Changping District, Beijing); the School of Software and Microelectronics (Daxing District, Beijing); and the Shenzhen Graduate School (Shenzhen, Guangdong). The specific provisions are as follows: 1. Disciplines and Majors For detailed information on majors and subjects, including the language of instruction, please consult the “ Peking University 2027 Master/Doctoral Admissions Major Catalogue (International Students) ” . 2. Method and Length of Study 1) Study methods for master’s or Ph.D. degree programs at Peking University are divided into full-time and part-time. For details on the learning methods for each major and focus, please refer to the “ Peking University 2027 Master/Doctoral Admissions Major Catalogue (International Students) ” . 2) Unless otherwise specified by the enrollment department (or program), the basic study period is 2 or 3 years for master’s degree students; 4 or 5 years for doctoral students; and generally 5 years for doctoral students admitted with only a bachelor’s degree. 3. Application Prerequisites Applicants must meet all of the following requirements: 1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid passport. Residents of the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau, or Taiwan who have emigrated to another country and are applying to Peking University as international students must present a valid passport or citizenship documents issued before April 30, 2021, and provide proof of the cancellation of Chinese nationality. Note: The exit and entry administration authority of the public security organ of China reserves the right to determine whether an applicant still holds Chinese nationality. If, during the application period or even after admission or registration, the applicant is found to still hold Chinese nationality, the applicant’s application, admission, registration, or enrollment will be nullified. 2) Applicants should be both physically and psychologically healthy, have no criminal record, and must comply with the laws and decrees of China and the regulations of Peking University. 3) Applicants to master’s degree programs must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher from a university or college accredited by the Ministry of Education of China. For certain professional degrees, such as Public Administration, Business Administration, Executive Business Administration, Law, and others, special application requirements apply and will be implemented in accordance with the Ministry of Education of China’s “2027 National Regulations for the Administration of Postgraduate Admissions.” Applicants to doctoral programs must hold a master’s degree or higher from an institution accredited by the Ministry of Education of China. Applicants with bachelor’s degrees may apply to doctoral programs in the sciences and engineering. 4) The applicant’s academic performance, academic level, and language ability should meet the admission requirements for the major they are applying to. 4. Application Period (Beijing time) October 26, 2026 – December 25, 2026 Note: For details on English-taught master’s programs, please consult the application guidelines for each program. 5. Application Materials Visit the International Student Service System ( https://www.studyatpku.com ) , complete the application, and upload the following documents: 1) Graduation and degree certificates, along with degree authentication in Chinese or English. For degree certificates in other languages, applicants must upload both the original copy and a notarized copy in Chinese or English. Degree diplomas awarded by overseas universities must be authenticated by the Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange, Ministry of Education, P. R. China (CSCSE) . Degree diplomas awarded by universities on the Chinese mainland must be authenticated by the Center for Student Services and Development, Ministry of Education, P. R. China (CSSD) . Note: Applicants who graduated before 2027 must upload their degree authentication report during the application period. Applicants expected to graduate in 2027 must provide an official letter from their current university confirming their expected graduation date and submit their graduation certificate upon pre-admission. 2) Official transc ripts of the applicant’s academic achievement, including courses taken and standards achieved. These must be original documents or notarized copies, in either Chinese or English. 3) A personal statement (including a research plan: 1500 words for the master’s degree program or 3000 words for the doctoral program). Please use the link to download the template: https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/downloads.php?cate=13 4) Résumé and a copy of the Application Commitment letter. Please click the link to download the Commitment letter template: https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/downloads.php?cate=13 5) Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors in the applicant’s major (or equivalent professionals with a relevant academic title), in Chinese or English. Once applicants submit a request, the application system will send a link to the recommenders. Recommenders should click the link and complete the recommendation either by filling out the form online or by uploading a scanned copy of the signed letter. To download the template, click the link: https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/downloads.php?cate=13 6) Original Chinese or English language test scores: ● For Chinese-taught programs, language test scores that meet the following standards are eligible for submission. Discipline HSK Writing section (composition) Science Subjects HSK 6, score above 200 Not lower than a score of 65 Humanities Subjects HSK 6, score above 210 Not lower than a score of 65 Note: Applicants who have taken the new HSK Levels 7–9 exam may submit corresponding qualifying score reports. ● Applicants to English-taught programs (projects) whose native language is not English must submit a TOEFL (iBT, 5 points or above; TOEFL scores of 100 or above obtained between September 1, 2025 and January 21, 2026, are also accepted), GRE (above 315), or other evidence of English proficiency. The specific requirements for English and Chinese language proficiency are subject to the admissions guidelines of each English-taught program. 7) Passport front page. Applicants must upload the front page of all ordinary passport(s) used continuously since April 30, 2021. The current passport must remain valid for at least three months beyond the date of enrollment. 8) Table of contents and abstracts of the applicant’s academic publications and any other original achievements in the applicant’s field (if applicable). 9) Some departments or schools may require additional application documents. Note: Applicants should scan the original or notarized application documents in color using a scanner. Images taken with a mobile phone or camera are not acceptable. Once confirmed, the applicant's passport details (including name, nationality, gender, date of birth, and the uploaded photo) submitted during the application phase cannot be modified before enrollment. Applicants must thoroughly review and ensure that all required documents (including two letters of recommendation) are complete and meet the specified standards before submitting them. Consequences of incomplete or non-compliant materials will be borne solely by the applicant. 6. Application Fee The application fee for each program or major is 800 RMB. Note: Each applicant may apply to up to two programs or majors. Applicants must pay the application fee online before the application deadline. Payments in other currencies or by traveler’s checks will not be accepted. Applications with incomplete documents or an unpaid application fee will not be processed. The application fee is nonrefundable. 7. Examination by the School/Department The International Student Division will review the applicant’s basic qualifications. After passing the review, the application materials will be forwarded to the admissions office of the relevant school or department for academic evaluation. The school’s (department, institute, center) admissions team will convene panels of experts to review applicants’ academic dossiers. All submitted application materials will be reviewed to assess each applicant’s overall ability. A shortlist of applicants will be prepared for the next stage of the examination. The second examination round will be held between January and March 2027. The exact date and time will be set by the respective school or department and posted on its website. Applicants should check the website regularly for updates. The school’s (department, institute, center) admissions expert committee will conduct a comprehensive assessment of the candidates’ research capacity, language proficiency, innovation capacity, and overall quality during the second examination round and rank the candidates. 8. Admission 1) Based on the school’s or department’s examination results, the Admission Office will review and prepare the preliminary admission list. 2) The preliminary admission list will be posted by the school or department before the end of May. Applicants should monitor the latest notices from the school or department. 3) The pre-admitted candidates should download and print the application form and, together with the other required original application documents (except the degree diploma and recommendation letters), deliver or mail the materials to the International Student Division of Peking University. Deadline: May 31, 2027 Address: Room 330, International Student Division, New Sun Student Center, Peking University. Please write on the envelope: “Graduate Student Application Materials.” 4) In late June 2027, the International Student Division will issue an admission notice, a “Confirmation Form for Study in China” (JW201/JW202), and other documents to admitted students in batches. 9. Enrollment Admitted students will complete registration and enroll at Peking University in early September 2027. The exact time will be announced in the admission notice. Admitted students must register at Peking University at the designated time with a valid passport, a valid visa, and an admission letter. All students should present their original degree diplomas for admission qualification review at the designated time. Students with degrees from overseas universities should, in addition, submit the authentication report issued by the Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange. If the relevant certificates have not been obtained before enrollment in the year of admission, the admission qualification shall be invalid. 10. Tuition Fees (per year per person) and Scholarships 1) Tuition Fees: Tuition Fees of Graduate Programs for International Students . 2) Scholarships: New international students may apply for the following scholarships: (1) Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B): includes a full or partial tuition waiver, free accommodation, monthly living expenses, and medical insurance provided in accordance with regulations. (2) Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students: Type A includes a tuition waiver, free accommodation, medical insurance, and monthly living expenses in accordance with the regulations; Type B includes a tuition waiver, free accommodation, and medical insurance; Type C includes a tuition waiver and medical insurance. (3) Peking University Scholarship for New International Students: includes a full or partial tuition waiver, monthly living expenses, and medical insurance. Note: Scholarship applicant evaluations will be conducted in accordance with applicable government and university regulations. For more information, please visit the International Student Division’s website at http://www.isd.pku.edu.cn. 11. Visa, Medical Insurance and Accommodation 1) Visa: Students admitted to PKU should apply for a student visa at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in their home country using the admission letter and the JW201/202 form. International students who will study in China for more than 6 months must obtain an “X1” visa, which is valid for only 30 days upon arrival in China. Upon arrival, they must visit the International Student Division and apply for a Residence Permit within 30 days to obtain legal status in China. 2) Medical Insurance: The Ministry of Education of China requires all international students to maintain medical insurance throughout their planned period of study. Students must purchase the ‘Comprehensive Insurance Plan for Foreign Students’ on the day of registration. Students without valid medical insurance will not be permitted to register. 3) Accommodations: Students with scholarships that cover housing will receive housing. Self-funded students should arrange their own housing on or off campus. Please note that students who live off campus must register with the local police station within 24 hours of arrival. 12. Graduation and Degree Awarding Students who have completed all the requirements stipulated in the academic plan and passed their thesis defense upon completion of their studies are permitted to graduate. After being examined and approved by the university’s Academic Degree Assessment Committee, the corresponding academic degree will be conferred. To provide opportunities for those who are not proficient in Chinese to pursue a PKU degree, Peking University has developed several English-taught programs, listed below. The China Scholarship Council (hereinafter referred to as “CSC”), entrusted by China’s Ministry of Education, is responsible for the admission, enrollment and administration of Chinese Government Scholarship recipients. I. Scholarship Categories and Application The University P rogram (Type B) is designed to finance the study of talented international students in China that are directly and recommended by designated Chinese universities. l A pplication receiving agency for University Program : Applicants shall file the application with Northwestern Polytechnical University for this program. l NPU is offering the University Program to Master and PhD international students. l NPU agency number: 10699 l Program Category selection: Type B l Application deadline s : The first batch: November 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026, 17:00 (GMT+8). The second batch: January 1, 2027 - February 28, 2027, 17:00 (GMT+8). Note: The application deadlines refer to the closing date for submissions via the Online Application System of NPU. In accordance with the requirements of CSC, NPU will submit the list of recommended candidates for this project in batches. II. Supporting Categories, Duration, Institutions, and Majors 1. Supporting Categories The University Program sponsors Master and PhD in NPU . 2. Duration The University Program covers major study period . The duration of the scholarship for major study conforms to that as required. 3. Institutions and Majors The majors that NPU offers to University Program have limitation. Type of the scholarship Full scholarship covers the tuition fee, dormitory fee, stipend and medical insurance. Partial scholarship covers one or some items of the full scholarship. 2. Details of the coverage (1) Tuition fees; (2) University dormitory or accommodation subsidy; (3) Stipend: Master’s students/general scholars: CNY 3,000 per month; Doctoral students/senior scholars: CNY 3,500 per month. Within the scholarship duration, registered scholarship students will receive a stipend from their host university each month. Students registering on or before the 15th of the month will receive a full stipend of that month. Those who register after the 15th of the month will receive a half stipend of that month. If registered student stays out of China for more than 15 days due to a personal reason (school holidays excluded), his stipend will be suspended during the period of absence. (4) Comprehensive medical insurance: CNY 800 per person per year; Please visit http://www.csc.edu.cn/studyinchina or http://www.campuschina.org and refer to Comprehensive Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China for insurance policy. NPU will review the CSC applications that are submitted by candidates of this program ; 6. NPU shall submit the recommended candidates list and their application documents to CSC in batches as required ; 7. CSC will organize designated universities and experts concerned to examine applicants’ eligibility and academic performance before finalizing the short-list candidates; 8. Ⅰ . Introduction ● Enrollment Quotas , Categories and deadline 1.Dalian University of Technology (DUT) is recruiting Master's and PhD students for the Chinese Government Scholarship -High Level Postgraduate Program and Chinese Government Scholarship - Silk-Road Program for the year 2027. The duration of the scholarships study is three years for master's students and four years for doctoral students. 2 The language of instruction is generally Chinese, with some programs are available in English. 3. Scholarships are granted for the duration of the study period determined at the time of admission, including specialized studies, and will not be extended in principle. 4. Scholarship recipients shall be managed in accordance with the relevant regulations of the Chinese Government Scholarship. Scholarship recipients are not allowed to change their institutions of admission; in principle, they are not allowed to change their majors and duration of study after coming to China. ● Qualifications 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 2. Education background and age limit: - Applicants for master degree programs must received bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35. - Applicants for doctor degree programs must received master's degree and be under the age of 40. 3. Satisfy the appropriate language requirements for the speciality you are applying for. ● Scholarship C ontent 1. Exempt from tuition, free on-campus accommodation provided; 2. Chinese Government Scholarship Comprehensive Medical Insurance provided. 4. International travel: self-sustained. Ⅱ . Application Time From November 1, 2026 to February 15, 2027. Ⅲ . Application Materials 1. Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form: The applicants for Chinese Government Scholarship should fill in the online application and print the application form and sign it after submitting it online. DUT Application Form: Application website: http://iso.dlut.edu.cn IF WE CANNOT CHECK YOUR INFORMATION IN DUT ONLINE APPLICATION SYSTEM, YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE CANCELED. 3. Notarized highest diploma: If applicants are university students, they shall also provide studying certificates. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. Applicants for PhD should provide undergraduate and master certificates. 4. The transcript shall be issued and sealed by the graduate university’s academic affairs office or student management department. Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. 5. Please expatiate on the major or research field you would like to study at DUT, and sign by DUT supervisors. Pls refer to the attachment 1. 6. Eligibility Outstanding academic performance and potential.
