tsinghua-guide.text: ﻿ Admission to Graduate Programs of Tsinghua University 2027（For International Students）-THU Graduate Admissions for International Students  中 Why THU Overview Beautiful Campus A Global University A Diverse Student Body Global Acclaim & Recognition Global Competence Programs Doctoral Degrees Master’s Degrees Joint Graduate Programs Graduate Programs in English Schools & Departments Short-term Research & Study Summer School Admissions How to Apply Evaluation and Admission Application Portal Frequently Asked Questions Download Costs Application Fee Tuition Fees Miscellaneous Expenses Financial Aid Financial Aid System Scholarship Application Frequently Asked Questions Contact Campus Life Accommodation Visa Application and Registration International Students & Scholars Center 中 News & Notice Home → News & Notice → Content 05 2026.09 Share   Admission to Graduate Programs of Tsinghua University 2027（For International Students） Tsinghua University (THU) offers Master's and Doctoral degree programs to international students across its 54 schools and departments ( 2027 program catalogs ) .Among these, 40 Master's and Doctoral degree programs are offered in English, while the rest are offered in Chinese or bilingually in Chinese and English. Required Qualifications of Applicants 1.Applicants must be foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality under the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China. At the time of application, they must hold a valid foreign passport or other valid proof of foreign nationality. l Applicants who were formerly Chinese citizens and subsequently acquired foreign nationality must no longer hold Chinese nationality. As of April 30 of the year of enrollment, at least six (6) years must have elapsed since they became foreign nationals or acquired foreign nationality. l For applicants whose parent or parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, who were born abroad, acquired foreign nationality at birth, and have never held Chinese nationality, the Chinese-citizen parent or parents must have obtained permanent residence in a foreign country by the time of the applicant’s birth. Applicants are required to submit application materials proving the above-mentioned circumstances in accordance with the requirements set out in Submission Instructions for International Graduate Applicants Regarding Nationality Status Documentation 2027 . If an applicant is found ineligible to apply, or if, before graduation or completion of studies, the applicant is determined not to qualify as an international student as defined in the Administrative Measures for the Enrollment and Cultivation of International Students by Schools (Order No. 42 jointly issued by the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Public Security), the University will take action according to the stage at which the issue is discovered. If discovered at the application stage, the applicant’s application eligibility will be revoked; if discovered before enrollment, the applicant’s eligibility to enroll will be revoked; if discovered after enrollment, the applicant’s admission qualification or student status will be revoked; and if discovered after graduation or completion of studies, any academic credential or degree certificate already issued will be revoked in accordance with the law. 2.Master's degree program applicants should have a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent degree to a Bachelor's degree (or above) in China. Doctoral degree program applicants should have a Master's degree or an equivalent degree to a Master's degree (or above) in China. *39 schools/departments can accept bachelor degree holders to pursue their doctoral degrees directly. Please see the application requirements on ‘ Application Instructions for Bachelor's Degree Holders to Pursue Doctoral Degrees ' and the ‘ Catalog of Doctoral Programs for International Students 2027 '. The students who will enroll in 2027 must obtain the nationally recognized bachelor's or master's degree（for the universities of Chinese mainland）or the degree authentication report issued by Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange,Ministry of Education,P.R.China(CSCSE) (for overseas universities) before THU graduate student registration date of 2027, otherwise the admission qualification is invalid. 3.Applicants should be in good health and of good character(meet the physical examination requirements stipulated by the country and THU), be well-behaved and be willing to abide by China's laws and regulations, as well as Tsinghua's rules. 4.Language competence requirements: The applicant's Chinese or English proficiency should meet the language proficiency requirements announced by relevant schools/departments in the ‘Remarks of Application 'of Catalog of Graduate Programs 2027 '. 5.Some programs have specific requirements for applicants' working years, etc. For relevant information, please refer to the remarks in the Catalog and the Admissions Guide of the programs. Note: The applicant shall carefully check whether he / she meets the application qualification and application requirements (including the application requirements declared by the target school/department/major/program) before applying. The relevant consequences arising from his / her failure to meet the application qualification and application requirements shall be borne by the applicant himself / herself. How to Apply Applicants should complete an Online Application (Apply Now) during the designated THU application period. (Exceptions: applicants for Schwarzman Scholars programs, please apply on the specified websites). Applicants should fill in the application information online, upload the application documents listed below to the Online Application System, and pay the application fee online at the time of submission. Application Schedule The application period is generally from September to February of the following year , but the deadline and application batches vary among different departments and schools. Please refer to the "Remarks of Application" in the Catalog for the specified deadline and application arrangements of each department or school or program. ☆The winter break of THU will be from Jan 21,2027 to Feb 17,2027. The application system will still be available during the winter break, but online verification might be delayed due to the vacation. Applicants are therefore recommended to complete their application at least two or three weeks in advance. ☆Documents pertaining to nationality and identity status must be submitted by the specified deadline, and no supplementary materials will be accepted after the application period concludes. Application Documents Please submit all the documents listed below to the application system: 1.Personal statement The personal statement should be completed directly in the application system. PhD applicants are also required to upload a brief research experience or research plan. 2.Degree certificate and degree authentication Master's degree program applicants should submit their Bachelor's degree certificate. Doctoral degree program applicants should submit both their Master's and Bachelor's degree certificates.The degree diploma awarded by overseas universities should be authenticated by Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange,Ministry of Education,P.R.China（CSCSE). The degree diploma awarded by universities of Chinese mainland should be authenticated by Center for Student Services and Development,Ministry of Education,P.R.China（CSSD） . Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline shall provide the expected graduation certificate first, and the degree diploma and degree authentication must be submitted before registration. (Applicants who have graduated are required to provide the degree authentication at the same time.) 3.Academic transcript Master's degree program applicants should submit the academic transcript of their undergraduate study. Doctoral degree program applicants should submit academic transcripts of both graduate and undergraduate studies.Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline shall provide their current academic transcript.In this case,the completed academic transcript must be submitted before registration.If the uploaded transcript cannot directly show the total GPA score, the GPA certification document issued by the university is also required. 4.Language Proficiency Test score report For related requirements of HSK score report or English score report,please check the‘Remarks of Application 'of Catalog.Applicants who complete their undergraduate or master's studies in Chinese must provide a certificate issued by the university they graduated from. After obtaining the permission of the applied school/department, they can be exempted from submitting the HSK score certificate. Those who intend to apply for scholarships (such as the Chinese Government Scholarship) must provide corresponding HSK score reports according to the requirements of the scholarship application. 5.Two academic recommendation letters Academic Recommendation Letters from scholars who hold the title of associate professor or higher, or senior professionals in a related academic field. Please follow the instructions on the online system for submission of online recommendation letters or upload the recommendation letters signed by references. 6.Passport (personal ordinary-type passport):Passport bio page Applicants should present bio page of personal ordinary-type passport. Applicant who holds personal ordinary-type passport and diplomatic visa in China should also provide the scanned copy of diplomatic visa page. 7. Nationality Status Documentation Applicants must submit the required nationality status documentation by the specified deadline in accordance with the requirements set out in Submission Instructions for International Graduate Applicants Regarding Nationality Status Documentation 2027 . 8.Some programs may require additional application documents; please check the 'Remarks of Application 'of the catalog or the program admission brochures. 9.For information on the required documents for Bachelor degree holders who wish to pursue Doctoral degrees, please see the ‘ Application Instructions for Bachelor's Degree Holders to Pursue Doctoral Degrees '. Note：Use the online application to apply. The online application system offers tools for collecting and submitting some, but not all of ,the documents and information required for application. Application Remarks 1.Applicants are required to submit scanned images of all required documents at the time of application. All uploaded documents should be in Chinese or in English; otherwise notarial translations in Chinese or English are required. Once translated, the original documents and certified translations should be submitted together to the application system. 2.Please scan the original or notarized application documents in color using a scanner. Images captured by mobile phone or camera are not acceptable. Scans of copies are also not acceptable. 3.For inquiries regarding program details, application for supervisors and the'Remarks of Application'in the catalog, please contact the applying department or program office directly. For personal information of supervisors, please check on the departments'/ schools'websites. 4.The application fee must be paid at the time the application is submitted. (It cannot be covered by the Chinese Government Scholarship). Please apply online and pay the application fee in a safe place. THU is not responsible for any losses caused by your own operation errors or the leakage of your online payment account and password. Please consider carefully before paying the application fee online. If you cannot finish the application due to various reasons, the paid application fee will not be refunded. Regardless of whether the application is successful or not, the application fee is not refundable. 5.Applications with incomplete documents or without application fee payment will not be processed.Applicants should take the initiative to understand the application procedures and application requirements before applying. The applicant will be responsible for any consequences arising from failure to complete the application process as required. 6.THU has the right to require applicants to provide original application materials or authentication documents issued by a designated institution for further inspection. 7.As some countries' higher education systems are very different from the Chinese system, applicants from different education systems should refer to THU’s online application website for reference.Click here 8.None of the above application documents will be returned. 9.If the higher-level department issues a new policy, THU will make corresponding adjustments. 10.Applicants must ensure that the application information,application materials,degree certificate and degree authentication provided are true and accurate. If the admissions unit or certification department verifies that anything in the application is not true, the application, admission or study qualification will be cancelled. 11.Applicants who are found to be in breach of academic ethics, professional ethics, honesty and trustworthiness, discipline and law-abiding，etc., will not be admitted or admission/study qualification will be cancelled after this breach has been verified. 12.The relevant information, documents and messages that the THU Graduate Admissions Office and relevant departments / schools publish or send to applicants through websites, phone calls, emails, text messages, etc. are deemed to have been delivered. All consequences caused by the applicant’s personal negligence and other reasons shall be borne by the applicant himself/herself. Evaluation and Admission THU admits students based on evaluation of their application documents together with a comprehensive assessment. The application materials are reviewed by an expert group of the relevant departments / schools, and the candidates for the comprehensive assessment will be selected based on the review results. The comprehensive assessment is generally based on interviews. The specific content, format, requirements and time arrangements are determined by each department / school and will be notified to applicants who enter the comprehensive assessment. Tsinghua University comprehensively considers the results of material review,comprehensive assessment and other factors, selects the best candidates, and determines the admission list . A Certificate of Admission and the appendix will be issued by THU after the final admission result is released. Prior to this, applicants may check their admission status via the Application System .(For Schwarzman Scholars programs' applicants, please check the respective programs' websites). Scholarships At present, Tsinghua University mainly provides the following scholarships for outstanding prospective full-time international graduate students. Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS): The Full CGS usually covers tuition fees, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance. The Partial CGS includes one or a few items covered by the Full CGS. Beijing Government Scholarship： The BGS usually covers tuition fees and comprehensive medical insurance with a duration of one academic year. For further information about scholarships, please click on‘ Financial Aid ’on the Graduate Admission Website. Accommodation Due to limited accommodation on campus, dormitory application must be made online on a first come first served basis. On-campus dormitories can only be reserved for full-time international students who successfully apply for rooms online. Those who fail to make it need to find off-campus accommodation by themselves. Detailed information regarding THU life, accommodation, student activities, visas and other useful information, is available on the International Students & Scholars Center website： http://is.tsinghua.edu.cn Visa Application and Registration Admitted students should apply for a student visa (X1 visa) at the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in their home country. To apply, students should provide their personal ordinary-type passport, Admission Notice and its Appendix, Confirmation Form for Study in China (JW201/JW202), and Physical Examination Record for Foreigners (applicants should confirm with the Chinese embassy/consulate for specific requirements). Students must enter China with an ordinary-type passport (nationality and personal information must be consistent with the passport information as applying) and X1 visa, and must apply for a Residence Permit within 30 days after arrival in China. Students are required to arrive at Tsinghua University and complete their university registration during the dates indicated in the admission package. Normally, registration is held in late August or early September. All students should present the required original degree certificates, and submit the degree authentication issued by THU designated institutions upon registration at Tsinghua University for enrollment qualification review. Students who fail the enrollment qualification review will be disqualified from enrollment and study at Tsinghua University. Costs (Unit: RMB Yuan) (1) Application Fee: RMB 800 (2) Tuition Fees of Graduate Program s : list of Tuition Fees 2027 (3) Accidental Injury and Hospitalization Insurance: RMB 800/year (4) Accommodation fee of student dormitories on Tsinghua campus, Beijing: RMB 40/bed/day per person for double rooms, RMB 30/bed/day per person for triple rooms. For accommodation on Tsinghua Shenzhen campus, please consult the Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School. Complaint Applicant who has any objection to the admissions process of the school/department, may file a complaint to the school/department in written form. The school/department should accept the complaint and respond. If the complainant disagrees with the reply, the complainant may appeal to the Graduate Admissions Office. University (SJTU) is one of China’s oldest and most prestigious institutions of higher education, renowned both in China and internationally. It is a national key university directly administered by the Ministry of Education of China and jointly supported by the Ministry and the Shanghai Municipal Government. With a history spanning more than 130 years, SJTU has developed into a comprehensive, innovative and internationally oriented university that ranks among China’s leading institutions and enjoys a global reputation. Its campuses, including Xuhui, Minhang, Huangpu, Changning, Pudong and Chongming, cover a total area of more than three million square meters. SJTU is authorized to award doctoral degrees in 57 first-level disciplines across 11 disciplinary categories: Economics, Law, Education, Literature, History, Science, Engineering, Agriculture, Medicine, Management and Interdisciplinary Studies. It is also authorized to award master’s degrees in 61 first-level disciplines across 12 disciplinary categories, as well as professional doctoral degrees in 16 categories and professional master’s degrees in 35 categories. SJTU offers graduate programs taught in Chinese or entirely in English to international applicants from around the world. Details of participating schools and programs are available in the SJTU 2027 International Graduate Program Catalog. Master’s programs normally take two to three years, and doctoral programs normally take four years. The specific duration is subject to the requirements of the program concerned. Students who complete the prescribed study plan, pass the thesis or dissertation review and defense, and fulfill all other graduation and degree requirements of their program will be awarded the corresponding graduation certificate and degree certificate. Note: The above figures are current as of October 2026. 1. Eligibility (1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a foreign ordinary passport for private purposes. Note: Whether an applicant holds Chinese nationality is determined by the exit and entry administration authorities of China’s public security organs. If, during the application or admission process or after enrollment, an applicant is determined by the competent authorities to hold Chinese nationality, or is found not to meet the University’s eligibility requirements, the University will revoke the applicant’s eligibility to apply, admission offer, eligibility to enroll, or student status, as applicable to the stage concerned. (2) Applicants must be of good character and in good physical and mental health, and must meet the medical examination requirements prescribed by the Chinese authorities and the University. They should have an understanding of and a friendly attitude toward China, be willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the University’s rules, and have no criminal record or record of other violations of laws, regulations or disciplinary rules. (3) Applicants for master’s programs must hold a degree equivalent to a Chinese bachelor’s degree. Applicants for doctoral programs must hold a degree equivalent to a Chinese master’s degree. Applicants in their final year of study who have not yet obtained the required degree may apply with a certificate of expected graduation issued by their university. They must obtain the degree required for their chosen program before registration and enrollment. (4) Some schools and programs accept applicants with a bachelor’s degree for direct entry to doctoral study. Specific eligibility requirements are set out in the admissions announcements and program catalogs issued by the relevant schools and programs. (5) Applicants must meet the applicable Chinese or English proficiency requirements specified in the Language Requirements for SJTU International Graduate Programs. 2. Online Application (1) Application Timeline Beijing Time November 5, 2026: Applications open. December 15, 2026: First-round application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. February 15, 2027: Final application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. March 31, 2027: Application deadline for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships. May 31, 2027: Application deadline for self-funded applicants. (2) How to Apply Applicants must log in the University’s online application system for international students ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ), complete the application form fully and accurately, upload all required documents, and submit their application. 3. Application Documents (1) Degree certificates and degree verification reports: Applicants for master’s programs must submit their original bachelor’s degree certificate. Applicants for doctoral programs must submit their original master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates. Applicants who obtained their degrees from universities outside the Chinese mainland are, in principle, required to submit a degree verification report issued by the Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange (CSCSE) , Ministry of Education of China. Applicants who obtained their degrees from universities in the Chinese mainland are, in principle, required to submit a degree verification report issued through CHSI (China Higher Education Student Information) , the official platform of the Center for Student Services and Development, Ministry of Education, China (CSSD). Note: Applicants in their final year of study may initially submit an official certificate of expected graduation issued by their university. The degree certificate and degree verification report must be submitted before enrollment and registration. Applicants who have already graduated should submit their degree verification reports at the time of application. (2) Academic transcripts: Applicants for master’s programs must submit authentic and complete undergraduate transcripts. Applicants for doctoral programs must submit authentic and complete transcripts for both their undergraduate and master’s studies. Applicants in their final year of study may initially submit their current transcripts and must provide their final transcripts before enrollment. If the uploaded transcripts do not directly show the overall grade point average (GPA), an official GPA statement issued by the university must also be provided. (3) Proof of language proficiency: Applicants must submit the documents specified in the Language Requirements for SJTU International Graduate Programs. (4) Passport: Applicants must submit a scanned copy of the biographical information page of their foreign ordinary passport for private purposes. The passport must remain valid for at least 12 months from the expected date of enrollment. Applicants whose passports do not meet this requirement should obtain a new passport promptly and use the new passport to complete their application. (5) Identification photo: The photo must be in JPG format, with a file size of less than 200 KB, a width of at least 295 pixels and a height of at least 413 pixels. (6) Personal statement and research plan: Applicants for doctoral programs must additionally upload a brief account of their research experience. (7) Two letters of recommendation: Referees should be academics holding the rank of associate professor or an equivalent or higher position, or senior professionals in a relevant industry. (8) Letter of Intent for Supervision from an SJTU Supervisor: Applicants to the following schools and institutes must submit this letter in accordance with the requirements for the relevant degree level and school or institute. Doctoral programs: School of Mechanical Engineering; School of Computer Science; School of Integrated Circuits (School of Information Science and Electronic Engineering); School of Materials Science and Engineering; School of Mathematical Sciences; School of Physics and Astronomy; School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology; School of Biomedical Engineering; School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering; School of Humanities; KoGuan School of Law; School of Foreign Languages; School of Agriculture and Biology; School of Pharmaceutical Sciences; Tsung-Dao Lee Institute; School of Design; College of Smart Energy; Antai College of Economics and Management; SJTU Paris Elite Institute of Technology; School of Oceanography; School of Psychology; Global Institute of Future Technology; School of Ocean and Civil Engineering; School of International and Public Affairs; School of Medicine. Master’s programs: School of Mechanical Engineering; School of Computer Science; School of Integrated Circuits (School of Information Science and Electronic Engineering); School of Materials Science and Engineering; School of Mathematical Sciences; School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology; School of Biomedical Engineering; School of Agriculture and Biology; School of Pharmaceutical Sciences; Tsung-Dao Lee Institute; SJTU Paris Elite Institute of Technology; College of Smart Energy; School of Oceanography; School of Psychology; School of Ocean and Civil Engineering; School of Medicine. Applicants to the relevant programs in the schools and institutes listed above must obtain a Letter of Intent for Supervision before submitting their application, in accordance with the requirements of the school or institute concerned. Contact details are available in the Contact Information for Schools and Institutes Offering International Graduate Programs in 2027. Note: All certificates, verification reports and supporting documents uploaded must be originals in Chinese or English. Documents issued in other languages must be uploaded together with notarized translations into English or Chinese. Documents must be scanned in color using a scanner. Photographs taken with a mobile phone or camera, and photocopies, are not accepted. 4. Fees (1) Application fee: RMB 800. Applicants should ensure that their application documents are complete and accurate before paying the application fee. The application fee is non-refundable. (2) Tuition: Tuition fees for individual programs are listed in the SJTU 2027 International Graduate Program Catalog. 5. Enrollment Enrollment is scheduled for September 2027. Admitted students must report to the University in person and complete registration and enrollment procedures in accordance with their Admission Notice and the guide for new students. 6. Scholarship Applications Scholarships for international doctoral students comprise Honorary Scholarships, Government Scholarships and SJTU Scholarships. Scholarships for international master’s students comprise Government Scholarships, SJTU Scholarships, SJTU Tuition Waiver Scholarships and School Scholarships. Details of scholarship amounts and funding periods are available in the application system ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ). (1)Eligibility (a) Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements for SJTU international graduate programs. (b) Applicants must not be receiving any other form of scholarship funding. (c) Applicants for doctoral study must be no older than 40. (d) Applicants for master’s study must be no older than 35. (2) Application Timeline Beijing Time November 5, 2026: Applications open. December 15, 2026: First-round application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. February 15, 2027: Final application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. March 31, 2027: Application deadline for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships. (3) How to Apply Applicants may apply for scholarships either through the University or through a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad. Applicants may choose only one of these two channels. (a) Applying through the University Eligible applicants must select the “Apply for scholarships through the University” option in the application system ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ). After the application deadline, the University will assess applicants’ documents and determine scholarship award levels in accordance with the applicable regulations and requirements. Applicants must complete the relevant scholarship application procedures by the deadlines specified in the University’s notifications. Please note the following: Applicants for the Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) must enter SJTU’s Agency Number, 10248, in the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System. Applicants who are not nominated by the University for the Chinese Government Scholarship will automatically be considered for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships. (b) Applying through a Chinese Embassy or Consulate Abroad Eligible applicants are encouraged to give priority to applying for the Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A) through a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad. Please contact the relevant embassy or consulate directly for information on eligibility, application procedures, required documents, the Agency Number, scholarship subcategories and any other requirements. Contact details are available on the website of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China ( https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/web/ ). Note: Applicants applying for scholarships through this channel must also complete their application in the University’s online application system for international students (http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ) by the applicable deadline and in accordance with this guide. (4) Scholarship Results Applicants may check their scholarship results in the application system ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ). The University will not issue separate written notifications of scholarship results. (5) Additional Information (a) Scholarship funding periods will not normally be extended. All scholarship recipients must undergo an annual review as required. (b) Annual review requirements and disbursement policies for the Chinese Government Scholarship are subject to the notices and regulations issued by the authorities responsible for administering the scholarship. (c) SJTU Scholarships, SJTU Tuition Waiver Scholarships and School Scholarships may cover all or part of the tuition fees. The specific coverage is subject to the funding package confirmed by the University or the relevant school. (d) Students may reserve on-campus accommodation as needed or arrange their own accommodation off campus. The University provides accommodation allowances according to the scholarship award level. 7. Tongji University adopts a material review system for admission and organizes written examinations or interviews for each college. We perform evaluations according to the overall capabilities of the students and select the best candidates for admission. 2. After submitting the application, the applicant must regularly check the information and application status in the application system and complete each step strictly as prompted. If the follow-up process is delayed due to failure to check a notification in time, the applicant is responsible for the delay. 3. After the school submits the recommended list to the China of China Scholarship Council (CSC), the CSC will organize experts in relevant disciplines to review the applicants' academic performance, comprehensive capabilities, development potential, and other aspects, and select the best candidates for admission. Applicants who have not been admitted will be transferred to other scholarship programs and self-funded programs at the University based on the individual's intention to fill out the application. 4. The International Student Office of Tongji University will inform applicants of the admission results. The university will not provide explanations for applications that do not pass the review. VII. Supporting Categories HIT Chinese Government Scholarship Programs sponsor master's and doctoral degree students. III. Scholarship Coverage 1. Tuition fee & on-campus dormitory fee . 2. Comprehensive medical insurance: CNY 10 00/year . 3. Monthly living allowance: No stipend is issued before arrival at the university. Master's degree students: CNY 3,000/month Doctoral degree students: CNY 3,500/month IV. Scholarship Duration 1. The standard study duration for Master’s programs is 3 years, with exceptions for certain faculties as listed below: • 2 years: School of Management , Business School, School of Instrumentation Science and Engineering • 2.5 years: Faculty of Computing 2. The duration of doctoral degree programs typically takes 4 years. V. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health . 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and comply with requirements specified in Ministry of Education Notice Document No.12 (2020) of P.R.China.（ http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A20/moe_850/202006/t20200609_464159.html ） Note: If an applicant is confirmed to hold Chinese nationality by Chinese public security authorities at any stage (application, admission or after registration), their application, admission or enrollment qualification will be revoked, and the College of International Education (CIE) reserves the right to dismiss the applicant from the university. 3. Academic & Age Requirement: Master ’ s Programs: Applicants must hold a bachelor ’ s diploma. Applicants shall be under 35 years old. Doctoral Programs: Applicants must hold a master ’ s diploma. Applicants shall be under 40 years old. 4. Consciously abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and the rules and regulations of the university. 5 . No Double Benefits Allowed - Students cannot receive multiple scholarships. VI. Application Documents 1. Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English) is available at http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/ . 2. Scanned bio-page of valid passport (passport expiry date shall be later than September 2027). 3. Scanned copy of original or notarized degree certificates from undergraduate level onwards (expected graduation certificate is acceptable for prospective graduates; the scanned original or notarized highest degree certificate must be submitted after admission) 4. Scanned original or notarized full academic transcripts covering all studies since undergraduate enrolment; partial transcripts are acceptable for prospective graduates, with full transcripts to be submitted upon admission. 5. Language proficiency certificate (must match the instruction language of your target program): Chinese-taught Programs: Valid HSK Level-4 score ≥ 210 (valid for 2 years). Applicants with a Chinese-medium instruction background may provide an official medium-of-instruction certificate issued by their previous university instead of an HSK score report; English-taught Programs: IELTS ≥ 6.0 (no individual band below 5.5), TOEFL iBT ≥ 80, or other equivalent English proficiency credentials. Applicants with an English-medium instruction background may provide an official medium-of-instruction certificate issued by their previous university. Native-English-speaking applicants are exempted from submitting English test scores. 6. Study Plan ( the template is below ； minimum 1,500 words, to be written in Chinese or English). 7. Two recommendation letters (referees to be professors or associate professors, including a comprehensive evaluation of the applicant ’ s study objectives, overall competence and future development potential). 8. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners ( the template is below ) . Valid within six months. Incomplete forms, forms without hospital stamp, physician signature or sealed photo will be deemed invalid. 9. Non-criminal record report, issued within six months before submission. 10. Supervisor Acceptance Letter (optional, the template is below ； applicants are encouraged to contact supervisors beforehand.) 11. For applicants currently studying in China: scan of passport visa page + official school performance certificate issued by your present institution. 12. Optional: Supporting materials including award certificates and research achievements. Important Note: 1. All application materials must be in Chinese or English . For materials in other languages, notarized translations must be provided. 2. All materials must be uploaded to the HIT online application portal. Hard copy documents will NOT be accepted. 3. Applications will not be processed unless the application fee has been paid online. 4. If an applicant is found to have submitted false information or fraudulent materials, the admission offer will be revoked, and the applicant shall bear all resulting consequences. 5. Applicants are NOT permitted to apply for more than one scholarship program simultaneously. Any duplicate applications will result in the cancellation of admission. VII. Application Procedures S tep 1: Login Chinese Government Scholarship Application System : http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/ and complete the application, download the CSC Application Form. Program Category Type: B HIT's University Code: 10213 S tep 2: Complete online application via HIT International Student Application Portal: https://apply.hit.edu.cn/ . Upload the CSC Application Form and other required documents, and pay the application fee. Step 3: Short-listed applicants will proceed to the interview assessment. The exact schedule will be notified via email. Note: Please use your own valid email address for system registration. All application-related notifications will be sent to this mailbox by the Admission Office. VIII. Admission and Notification 1. HIT can adjust the selected majors and study duration according to the applicant's educational background and study plan. If the applicant's conditions or application documents do not meet the provisions or requirements, the application shall be considered invalid and not accepted. 2. Scholarship recipients shall read carefully the information in the admission letter. Upon arrival in China, the university will not entertain any applications for inter-university transfer, transfer between schools or majors, or changes to study duration, medium of instruction or supervisor. Program is designed to finance the study of talented international students in China that are directly recommended by designated Chinese universities. I. Supporting Categories, Duration and Instruction Language (1) Supporting Category: The University Program supports undergraduate students and graduate students. (2) Duration: The duration of scholarship funding corresponds to the length of the major study as determined at the time of admission. (3) Instruction Language: Chinese or English. II. Where and When to Apply (1) Agency Name: Beijing Normal University (2) Agency Number: 10027 (3) When to apply: Applicants need to apply between November and March. III. Scholarship Coverage and Standard (1) Tuition (2) Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy (3) Stipend (4) Comprehensive medical insurance Please refer to Application Guide for Chinese Government Scholarship (https://www.campuschina.org/scholarships) for details of each item. IV. Applicants Qualification (1) The applicant should meet the requirements of BNU Admission Brochure for International Students. (2) The University does not provide preparatory Chinese language courses for the applicants of Chinese-taught degree programs. Please submit the HSK certificate according to the admission requirements of your program. (3) Applicants should not be holding any other scholarships. (4) The requirements for applicants' degree and age are that applicants must: Be a high school graduate and no more than 25 when applying for the undergraduate programs. Be a bachelor's degree holder and no more than 35 when applying for the master's programs. Be a master's degree holder and no more than 40 when applying for the doctoral programs. V. Application Procedure (1) Please follow the instruction of BNU admission information for international students and prepare the application documents. Please log on to the "BNU International Student Application System" (https://international.bnu.edu.cn/) to complete an online application. (2) Read carefully the Instructions for Chinese Government Scholarship Information System ; Register on the website of CSC (http://www.csc.edu.cn/studyinchina or http://www.campuschina.org) ; complete, print and sign the Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship. To apply through the Chinese University Program as a new student, please choose Type B; the Agency number for Beijing Normal University is 10027. * Please note: re-submission of the form is required if you have made any modification. (3) Submit the required paper application documents to Beijing Normal University before the deadline. VI. Application Documents (1) Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (filled in online). (2) Applicants are required to submit a clear scanned copy of the information page of their ordinary passports. If the validity period of the currently held passport is less than 12 months (calculated from the expected start date of study), please renew the passport and use it to complete the scholarship application. An applicant who fails to apply for a passport due to objective reasons may submit valid documentation or documentary evidence that carries information about the full English name, gender, nationality and date of birth of the applicant upon the approval of the application receiving agency. (3) Diploma and certificate of highest education (notarized photocopy). An applicant who is a current university student shall submit the certificate of expected graduation or student status issued by his/her university. (4) Academic records. Academic records in languages other than Chinese or English shall be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. (5) Certificate of language proficiency. When applying for a Chinese-taught program, an applicant shall provide a valid HSK score report that meets the program's language ability requirements. When applying for a program taught in a language other than Chinese, an applicant shall provide a certificate of proficiency in the language as required by the designated university, such as the IELTS or TOEFL test report. (6) CSCA Score Report. Applicants seeking to pursue a bachelor's degree must register for and take the CSCA before the application deadline, and submit a valid CSCA Report. (7) Language qualification certificates. Applicants for master's, doctoral, general scholar, and senior scholar programs taught in Chinese must submit a valid HSK score report that meets the corresponding Chinese language proficiency requirements. Applicants for programs taught in other languages are required to provide relevant language proficiency certificates, such as IELTS or TOEFL score reports, in accordance with the requirements of each university. (8) A study or research plan written in Chinese or in English (no less than 200 words/characters for undergraduates; no less than 500 words/characters for scholars; no less than 1000 words/characters for postgraduates). (9) Recommendation letters. An applicant for a postgraduate program or for academic education as a senior scholar shall submit two recommendation letters in Chinese or in English from professors or associate professors. An applicant for a undergraduate program shall submit a recommendation letter from a teacher, head teacher, or school leader of the high school. Signature of the referee is required. (10) An applicant for the arts or design program shall provide his/her own works (such as videos and paintings). (11) An applicant under the age of 18 shall submit the legal documents of his/her legal guardian(s) in China. (12) An applicant to study in China for more than six months shall submit a photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form (the original document, printed by Chinese quarantine authorities, shall be filled in in English and kept by the applicant). The medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form . Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are invalid. Medical examination results are valid for only six months. (13) An applicant shall submit a valid Certificate of Non-Criminal Record (or Police Clearance Certificate) issued by the local public security (such as the police station), usually issued within six months prior to the submission date of the application. Attention: (1) Applicants must submit application documents that meet the requirements of both the Beijing Normal University admissions brochure and the Chinese Government Scholarship Application Documents List . (2) If the applicant has not obtained the Pre-admission Letter issued by BNU when filling in the Chinese Government Scholarship Application System, he/she can temporarily complete the application without submitting this document. However, after the applicant has obtained the Pre-admission Letter issued by BNU, he/she must submit it to the Chinese Government Scholarship Application System as soon as possible. VII. Admission and Scholarship Results (1) BNU will review the application documents and decide the nominated candidates. Nominated candidates will get Chinese Government Scholarships to study in China with approval of the CSC. (2) CSC reserves the rights to decide the host university for scholarship recipients with multiple offers. Applicant Qualifications 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens. 2. In good physical and mental health, with excellent academic performance and conduct, and in compliance with Chinese laws, regulations, and university rules. 3. Not concurrently funded by any other Chinese government or institutional scholarship. 4. Educational and age requirements: — Master’s program: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) with excellent academic record; under 35 years old. — Doctoral program: Master’s degree (or equivalent) with excellent academic record; under 40 years old. 5. Language requirements: — Chinese-taught programs (meet one of the following): 1) HSK Level 5 ≥ 180; or 2) Degree obtained from a Chinese university with Chinese as the language of instruction (HSK exempt). — English-taught programs (meet one of the following): 1) TOEFL ≥ 80 or IELTS ≥ 6.0; 2) English is the native/official language; 3) Degree obtained with English as the medium of instruction. II. Majors NENU Master’s and Doctoral Programs for International Students 2026 ( Click to view ) III. Scholarship Coverage 1. Tuition and on-campus accommodation fees are waived. 2. Monthly living allowance in China: RMB 3,500/month for Ph.D. students and RMB 3,000/month for Master’s students. 3. Comprehensive medical insurance during the study period in China. IV. Application Deadline From now until February 22, 2026 (Beijing Time) V. Application Procedures Step 1 : Apply via the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System Visit http://www.campuschina.org to register an account. Select Program Category Type B and enter Agency Number 10200 (Northeast Normal University). Complete the required information, submit the application online, and download the Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form. Please refer to the Application Guide for details. Step 2 : Apply via the NENU International Student Service System Log in to http://studyatnenu.nenu.edu.cn or https://nenu.17gz.org to complete and submit the online application. Please refer to the Application Guide for details. Once submitted, the application cannot be modified. Step 3 : Review and Interview NENU will review each applicant’s academic background, language proficiency, and professional competence, and organize online interviews for qualified candidates. Interview notifications will be sent via email. Step 4 : Preliminary Review and Nomination By mid-March 2026, NENU will complete the preliminary review, confirm the list of nominated candidates, and send Pre-admission Notices via email. Step 5 : Upload Pre-admission Notice and Supplementary Materials Nominated candidates must log back into the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System ( http://www.campuschina.org ) within the specified time to upload the Pre-admission Notice and supplementary materials as instructed by NENU’s email. Failure to complete this step on time will result in disqualification. Step 6 : Final Evaluation and Admission Based on the principle of “individual application–institutional recommendation–expert review–merit-based admission,” the China Scholarship Council will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of each candidate’s academic performance, overall competence, and development potential, and admit the best-qualified applicants. VI. Application Documents 1. Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form . To be completed online in Chinese or English. 2. Passport information page and all Chinese visa pages (if any). The passport must be valid beyond September 2026. 3. Notarized degree certificates (from the undergraduate level onward) . Current students must submit a Certificate of Expected Graduation issued by their university. Applicants must obtain the required degree before September 2026. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be accompanied by notarized translations into Chinese or English. 4. Academic transcripts (from the undergraduate level onwa rd) . Scanned copies must include all study records (bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral, if any) up to the latest semester, issued and stamped by the academic affairs office, graduate school, or student management department. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be accompanied by notarized translations into Chinese or English. 5. Language proficiency certificate . Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must provide a valid HSK Level 5 certificate (≧180 points) or proof of a degree obtained in Chinese-medium instruction at a Chinese university. Applicants for English-taught programs must provide a TOEFL score of 80 or above, or IELTS score of 6.0 or above, or proof of an English-medium degree. 6. Research proposal . A research proposal in Chinese or English (minimum 1000 words) is required. For doctoral applicants, it must be signed by the intended NENU supervisor. Template available at the Download section of the Studyatnenu website ( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Download.htm ) 7. Two recommendation letters. Written only in Chinese or English by professors or associate professors shall be submitted. The letters should be signed by the recommenders and indicate their identity and contact information. These letters shall describe the applicant's objective of learning in China, comprehensive abilities, and evaluation of future growth, as well as the cooperation between the supervisors or the exchange between universities both in China and abroad. 8. Portfolio (if applicable). Applicants for arts or design majors should submit samples of personal work (such as videos or artwork). 9. The Physical Examination Form for Foreigners. The Form is issued by the Chinese quarantine authority and must be completed in English. Template available at the Download section of the StudyatNENU website( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Download.htm ). The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take a physical examination, as the result is valid for only 6 months. 10. Non-criminal record. The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-criminal record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months before the submission date of the application. 11. Academic achievements (if any). Such as published papers or patent certificates. 12. Conditional acceptance letter (if any). Applicants may contact supervisors for the conditional acceptance letter(optional). Template available at the Download section of the StudyatNENU website( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Download.htm ). For teachers’ information, please visit the Faculty Profile section of the StudyatNENU website ( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Faculty_Profiles.htm ). 13. Other supporting documents required by the International Students Office. Note: All uploaded documents must be clear, authentic, and valid. Applicants should use professional scanning devices and bear responsibility for unclear materials. VII. Admission and Registration 1. NENU will inform applicants of the final admission results by email before July 2026 and send the Admission Notice and the Confirmation Form for Study in China (JW201). 2. Scholarship recipients must register at NENU in late August or early September 2026 as specified in the Admission Notice. Those who fail to register on time without prior approval will be considered to have given up the admission, and the scholarship will not be retained. VIII. Notes 1. Applicants must apply directly to Northeast Normal University and should not submit applications through any agency. If found, the scholarship application will be disqualified. 2. If necessary, NENU will contact applicants via admission@nenu.edu.cn to request supplementary materials or inform them of admission results. Please ensure that the email address provided is accurate. 3. Scholarship recipients are not allowed to receive financial support from CSC and other scholarships (excluding all kinds of one-time scholarships) provided by the Chinese government at all levels and the host university at the same time; once discovered, their eligibility for the CSC Scholarships shall be canceled, and they shall be required to return the scholarship they have already received. For those who deliberately conceal their financial support situation, in addition to disqualification, they will not be allowed to apply for CSC Scholarships within three years. 4. Scholarship recipients who fail to register within the specified time will lose their eligibility. Bringing family members without university approval is not permitted. 5. Upon registration, scholarship recipients must submit all original application documents. Applicants are responsible for the authenticity of their information. Any false or misleading materials will result in the cancellation of admission or student status. 6. Scholarship recipients must participate in the annual review as required. Those who fail the evaluation will have their scholarships suspended or canceled. 7. In principle, scholarship recipients are not allowed to change their major or duration of study. IX.
